notes: «أخبرني يونس، ومالك، وأسامة» are three co-transmitters of one level; «عن الحسن، وعبد الله، ابنى محمد» names the two sons, and «ابنى محمد» is read as a description, not added as a link; needs_ruling because rule 7 may make «محمد» the link standing between the sons and «أبيهما»; «عبد الله» is occurrence 2 (occurrence 1 is «عبد الله بن وهب»); «أبيهما» is named only by relation, so it is a relation link
